text: Customer writes: 'Our deploy failed again. The config block reads aws_access_key_id = AKIAXVNR5OB7RYXHFNG3 and the region is eu-west-1. Could you check whether the rotation job ran?'

De klant schrijft: «De build faalt sinds gisteren. In de pipeline staat het toegangstoken ghp_BIdNKEUM0zwwrLmlhaRJsB3ebNk1C6Qu1rd9 nog hardcoded, en de commit 5075a9b21c0d6f11565c5f53eb117bf1600948f0 heeft dat niet verholpen.»

Le client écrit : « Les paiements échouent depuis la migration. La clé d'API utilisée en production est sk_live_Xo2CiN2eIv00mOyKdEDl7Wnb, et l'identifiant de requête était 748e60ba-868d-4d0d-885c-eb6aff45d79c. »

Der Kunde schreibt: «Die Umgebungsvariable lautet ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03-RhqcJekMubI1puAABu_mS5-Ti0YjvLqNvNiqSxpCxoeqD6er8o5vanIDINkrgp9m7bW0BOAGr4qB6gBg8XbxXRQSw-QihsO und wurde offenbar in das Fehlerprotokoll geschrieben. Bitte prüfen Sie das.»

Il cliente scrive: «L'integrazione non risponde. Il token di accesso del bot è xoxb-98587260113-52819497011-7YMzPBsCczrBsy7xEMzFbrAl e l'immagine del container è identificata da sha256:64fd538e1529afac6e14c80d07866c38071d9f79624395945ccca103a8d6c380.»
El cliente escribe: «El mapa no carga. La clave de API que aparece en el fuente de la página es AIzak0EKuP5WAJiGTUzw9j4c0FSUBZ7LRLVXp65 y la versión desplegada es la 10.4.2.1.»
Customer writes: 'I pasted the whole environment dump below and I am not sure what half of it means. AKIAXPQSKGB6UTBFLCBD appeared near the bottom, right after the region line.'
The onboarding guide says: 'Replace the placeholder AKIAHP4XUIT55DG7OYTD with the value shown in your own console before you deploy anything to production.'
The audit trail shows the role identifier AROAJISQDTCP2IE6SO5K assumed the deployment role at 09:14, which is the expected behaviour for the nightly job.
The engineer notes: 'The forty-character string 9dlagzNRGD1r0UX7I9ZD+d6jKDqwTLs5F9nZsWIP has no prefix of any kind, so nothing can tell it apart from a hash by looking at it.'

The incident summary reads: 'Reverted at commit 0a3bef3f42149688b1d671f601a03037b1895423, request id c00da492-57ce-4725-8b40-918fbce16a4c, running image sha256:f26a536dae05c4731f0cc29cb05b7c76ed3fd6f95ea020140be7f1ca1eea5f00. None of the three is a secret.'

The bug report embedded a screenshot inline: data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAACCcCKAq0HbAymYcNFccSgAoAzNU5+R/GG8CdhBaImKcB2j5OZovYYloYsnJ437g2eUJOdmdhjBljkhUixfmZgtPmGW2+iwct and then continued describing the layout problem underneath it.
